+++ b/tests/test_regression_stock_integrity.py
@@ -0,0 +1,32 @@
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+
+from inventory_api import app as inventory
+from inventory_api.app import app
+
+client = TestClient(app)
+ALICE = {"Authorization": "Bearer token-alice"}
+BOB = {"Authorization": "Bearer token-bob"}
+
+
+def setup_function():
+    inventory.STOCK.update({"A-100": 100, "B-200": 20, "C-300": 3})
+    inventory.RESERVATIONS.clear()
+
+
+def available(sku: str) -> int:
+    return client.get(f"/stock/{sku}").json()["available"]
+
+
+def test_negative_qty_must_not_inflate_stock():
+    resp = client.post("/reservations", json={"sku": "A-100", "qty": -15}, headers=BOB)
+    assert resp.status_code >= 400
+    assert available("A-100") == 100
+
+
+def test_double_cancel_must_not_return_stock_twice():
+    rid = client.post("/reservations", json={"sku": "C-300", "qty": 2}, headers=BOB).json()["id"]
+    assert client.delete(f"/reservations/{rid}", headers=BOB).status_code == 200
+    assert available("C-300") == 3
+    second = client.delete(f"/reservations/{rid}", headers=BOB)
+    assert second.status_code != 200
+    assert available("C-300") == 3
